label: Logical psychologism and truth-directed psychological realization
summary:
Continues #1989 and #1007. Compared actual habits, ideal dispositions, constitutive practices, evolutionary/functional and truth-sensitive realization accounts under a fixed classical interpretation. MP and affirming the consequent differ on the explicit countervaluation p=false, q=true despite equal acceptance. Exhaustive Python comparison of four valuations, four acceptance profiles and all Boolean classifiers confirms failure exactly for equal acceptance data. Reuses the fixed semantic entailment and criterion characterization. F1 is case-predicate noncontradiction, not anti-psychologism; applying it requires same predicate/respect and factive conflicting verdicts. Thin F6 excludes denial of every reason for the same relation; denial of irreducibility is not that denial. Existing warranted acceptance and reason bearer routes retain their exact bridges. Proposed Lean application, controls, warrant comparison and reproduction commands are in docs/notes/logical-psychologism.md. Continuation: tested normality and nomic inevitability, perfect restricted performance, reliability, role/content calibration, selected function, correctness/authority and realization/reduction as separate hypotheses. Any omitted individually isolatable valuation permits a false positive with a tautological premise; all fourteen nonempty proper scopes of the four-valuations carrier were tested, with the full scope control. In a fixed complete syntactic response map, diagonal labels plus MP soundness leave material implication and equivalence; AC soundness selects equivalence, a true off-diagonal label selects material implication. Full-support conditional AC error is 1/(n-2) for the specified positive masses, so arbitrarily high reliability is insufficient for deductive validity. Exact zero counterexample mass in a finite full-support truth-calibrated frame is sufficient. Reuses ReflectiveCoherence and the existing correction result; locally elaborated Lean applications and exact Python checks in the same note. Both Python comparisons rerun successfully. No registration or ground-of-logic theorem claimed.

Curation pass 2, lane D batch 4 (#2103, 2026-11-27). b203c461 remains unplaced. In the sole Unit world, the content `true` holds and entails itself. The same world refutes entailment from `true` to `false`. The first row refutes `NoValidInference booleanProfile`, whose registration `3e6a8e08` is off path.
blocker: Strongest surviving account supplies independently calibrated compositional truth conditions and full semantic coverage; test a specified complete descriptive functional base rather than bare internal response or a restricted benchmark. Does that base derive the truth conditions and countercase scope of the same abstract contents without presupposing semantic correctness? Actual proof-uptake F6 application also remains open; do not conflate validity with warrant or preference-independent authority.

current_assessment.scope: Psychologism's validity criterion and its non-eliminative functional retreats; consequences for exact F1 and thin F6 under fixed classical semantics.
current_assessment.assessment: Bare occurrence, approval, normal functioning inside a restricted domain, nomic inevitability and arbitrarily high full-support reliability do not suffice for unrestricted deductive validity. Exact scoped evaluation suffices only if it includes at least one countervaluation per invalid sequent in the selected class. For MP and AC alone 01 suffices. Including every isolating sequent requires every valuation. At n=4 the true AC premises leave the prior for p unchanged. At n>4 they raise it in the specified distribution. A reason for a subject can follow either from warranted acceptance with both calibrations, or directly from an actual surviving basis for the same subject and content under the surviving-support calibration. A fixed syntactic response map plus diagonal calibration does not select the material conditional; adding soundness of both rules selects equivalence, while an independently true off-diagonal condition selects material implication. These results localize the burden of a non-eliminative reduction to content calibration and semantic scope, separately from reason-giving force. A truth-directed functional account with these constraints survives; no ontological nonreduction theorem or additional F1/F6 establishment. Prior F1/F6 and #930 authority judgments retain their scope.
current_assessment.next_test: Give a precise non-semantic relational/functional base for abstract contents and compare its full data, not only the syntactic response table, against the two candidate truth functions and omitted-world construction. Verify its countercase coverage and independent content-selection condition, then ask whether it supports actual warranted proof uptake using the existing F6 calibrations.
current_assessment.evidence: The independent recheck accepted the scope, calibration, meaning of the AC conditional probability and subject-level F6 applications at 6abbeb2d2e6a32be230c0035e4c3db4e9bcf65ee. PR-1990. Both Lean blocks elaborated together and both displayed finite comparisons passed. The original reviewed #931 and #1987 findings retain their stated scopes.

No meaning or proof status changed.
